Starter ~$54 / Growth ~$124 / Pro ~$284 per month; month-to-month, $0 setup. Bootstrapped, team 2–5, founded Apr 2026, US. Listed for sale at $2.5M on TrustMRR.

whyItPrints: Done-for-you content factory sold as SaaS seats. 589 subs × mid-tier ARPU = real print without building another UGC toy. Productized agency with dashboard delivery.
whyThisMatters:
A monthly plan buys faceless video from a small team. They write the script, record an AI voice, edit, and make the thumbnail, plus the title, tags, and description. Each channel gets its own narrator. You stay off camera. The networks are YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

You can download the files and post them, or connect an auto-poster that schedules YouTube and can copy the video out to the other networks. Plans differ by how many long videos and shorts you get, and by whether that's one channel or several. They say a normal batch arrives in about five business days. Plans are month to month.

The company is in the US, bootstrapped, with a team of two to five, and it started in April 2026. The listing is for sale. They say they'll cover more than a hundred niches.
